statements.notes:
Give your immune system a tune up with Culturelle
Your health & wellness begins in the core of your body, the digestive tract. Yet diet, daily stress, travel and some medications can occasionally disrupt the balance of good bacteria which can leave you open to a host of issues.
Culturelle Health & Wellness contains 15 billion CFUs of the LGG strain, the most clinically studied probiotic strain, and delivers clinical strength immune support.

Supports your immune system
Boosts digestion
Works naturally with your body

Unleash the power of your microbiome!
Your gut microbiome helps support an overall healthy you because it's linked to your digestive health, cognition, mood, nutrition, and immune system.
You can trust your gut daily to Culturelle.
Storage instructions: Store Culturelle in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
Tamper evident: Product is sealed within blisters. Do not use if any part of the blister is torn, open or damaged.
Allergy friendly

Keep out of reach of children.

Inform a healthcare professional before starting any dietary supplement, particularly if there is a known immune-compromised condition.
When first taking a probiotic, your gut microbiome adjusts. You may experience minor bloating, gas or intestinal gurgling which should subside with continued use. Consult your healthcare professional if symptoms continue after two weeks.
For questions, concerns or to report an adverse event please call (800) 722-3476.
